rv.q: I just hope Pharel, a true poet with a wicked sense of humor, will strike out from the nonprofit-MFA mainstream, not worry so much in the future about hitting every perceived righteous button, and let her deeply spirited and richly individualized characters tell her where they themselves want to go, rather than feel like an authorial mouthpiece.
The true beauty of this production, besides the wonderful Quinceañera gowns by costume designer Raquel Adorno, is that the language is much less preachy than my intro here.
It is in turns hilarious, dramatic, and disturbing, and never anything less than marvelously truthful.
Pharel and the company prove themselves to be accomplished artists and one cannot help but be excited by what they will do next for the theater industry.
Phanesia Pharel’s first full-length play is most promising.
This thought-provoking play is an extraordinary experience that every family, especially mothers and daughters, should witness together.
Dead Girl’s Quinceañera is ambitious, culturally layered and unapologetically youthful.
“Dead Girl’s Quinceañera” convincingly examines the subtle ferocity of girlhood and the intricacies of growing up.
It’s a strange contradiction, but, as a whole, Dead Girl’s Quinceañera is both greater and lesser than the sum of its parts.
The storytelling transitions aren't smooth. QUINCEAÑERA is all fun and games until it's not.
Amusing, sad, touching, and real, I found myself lingering on every word and hanging on each new piece of information.
What's remarkable about this Jekyll and Hyde is how nearly perfect it is.
A very impressive 90 minutes of theater!
The piece is fun to watch, engaging, even charming.
The message in Dead Girl's Quinceañera is one worth seeing this show for, but the set-up and plot, in this writer's opinion, still needs work.

cn.t: Critics praise this darkly comic mystery about teens investigating a friend's disappearance for its sharp writing and heart, though some find it overstuffed with themes. Strong performances and cultural authenticity resonate.
